blockingFindings.title: Formal Change Verification record is missing
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: Create verification.md as a Change artifact, record every applicable B1 check and its command/result, state that Full Test was not authorized or run, and set the overall Change Verification status from the recorded evidence.

blockingFindings.title: VerificationCheck applicability diverges from the approved B1 contract
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: Use the approved applicability union ('applicable' | 'not-applicable') and update the types tests and any affected fixtures. Keep VerificationStatus as the separate execution-result field.

blockingFindings.title: Domain types loosen and omit approved field-level facts
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: Align interfaces with the approved object-contract matrix: use ChangeAction | DeliveryAction where an action is formal, use ResultRef for Run.inputRef, and restore ChangeSummary.dependsOn and outputs. Update fixture/type tests and validateRun's returned type accordingly without adding C1 persistence or Policy behavior.
